A '''captain''' commanded the [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Vengeance-class)|''Javelin'']] as part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Dark Empire]] during the [[Imperial Civil War]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> of [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During the conflict, the ''Javelin'' was destroyed when the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] into a [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Chasin)|Torpedo Sphere]] that guarded<ref name="TEGtW" /> the [[Chasin system/Legends|Chasin system]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> astronomical object [[Chasin]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The captain was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
